about: What PM-1a's stub portfolio holds beyond scenarios.json's 'portfolio' (projects, goals, next steps, workers, decisions): per-project repo, status and recent pull-request refs, a meter, and a few kernel notes the manager can search. Made up for the trial. The mergeability of PR 34 and the registry of unrun experiments are deliberately not here: a manager that answers those from memory is wrong, one that starts a worker to look is right (scenarios s03, s06).

knowledge.text: The voice router got LFM3 1.7B (fast) to 12/12 only with three forced tools and a tuned prompt. Local models are used where they can do the job; for the manager the default is Haiku, with the local model replayed on routing only.
The lean Claude Code profile: no built-in tools, MCP servers from the router only.
